response.sql: WITH funding_metrics AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS funding_source, AVG((s.boxy - s.boxx) * 1.0 / NULLIF(s.boxx, 0)) AS avg_y_vs_x_difference, SUM(s.aream2) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(s.volm3), 0) AS area_to_volume_ratio FROM scanspatial AS s JOIN projects AS p ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry GROUP BY p.fundflux), benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(area_to_volume_ratio) AS avg_ratio FROM funding_metrics) SELECT f.funding_source, f.avg_y_vs_x_difference, f.area_to_volume_ratio, f.area_to_volume_ratio - b.avg_ratio AS amount_above_average FROM funding_metrics AS f CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE f.area_to_volume_ratio > b.avg_ratio;
